meta.title: 第41讲 · 特殊疑问句 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身认识特殊疑问句 → 疑问词选哪个 → how 家族大点兵 → what 的多面手 → 语序三定律 → 易错七对辨真身 → 综合验收（共 7 关 · 50 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：特殊疑问句是什么
nodes.explain:
一般疑问句用 Yes / No 就能打发，特殊疑问句不行——它以特殊疑问词开头，盯住陈述句里的某一块提问，问什么答什么，不能用 yes / no 回答：

What's your name? → (My name is) Jerry. / How old is he? → (He is) 5 years old. / When do they often watch TV? → (They often watch TV) after supper.

疑问词分三大家族，先混个脸熟：

家族成员
疑问代词（问人、物）what 什么 · which 哪一个 · who / whom 谁 · whose 谁的
疑问副词（问时间、地点、方式、原因）when 什么时候 · where 在哪里 · how 怎样 · why 为什么
How 词组how often 多久一次 · how long 多长 · how many / how much 多少 · how soon 多久以后 · how far 多远 · how old 多大年纪 · how many times 多少次

本讲的玩法就一句话：看划线部分是什么身份，就派哪个疑问词上场。身份认得越准，题做得越快。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。

general_qs.stem: 特殊疑问句和一般疑问句最大的不同是？
options: 特殊疑问句以疑问词开头，不能用 Yes / No 回答，问什么答什么
一般疑问句没有疑问词
特殊疑问句不用变语序
general_qs.answer: B. 特殊疑问句以疑问词开头，不能用 Yes / No 回答，问什么答什么
general_qs.explain: 特殊疑问句盯住句中某一块提问，回答要给实际信息：What's your name? → Jerry。A / C / D 都是拿句子长短、语序说事，没说到点子上。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪一组全是疑问副词？
general_qs.explain: 疑问副词管时间、地点、方式、原因：when / where / how / why。A / D 是疑问代词（问人、物）；C 是 How 词组——三家要分清。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪一个不是 How 词组？
general_qs.explain: what size（什么尺码）是 what 家族的。How 词组的常用成员：how often / long / many / much / soon / far / old / many times。

general_qs.stem: 对方回答 (My name is) Jerry. 你应该问：________ ________ your name?
general_qs.explain: 问姓名用 What：What is your name?（= What's your name?）。回答的是「名字」这个信息，不是 yes / no。

general_qs.stem: He is 5 years old. → ________ ________ is he?（对 5 years old 提问）
general_qs.explain: 对年龄提问用 how old：How old is he? → (He is) 5 years old。

nodes.title: ② 疑问词选哪个：时间 · 地点 · 人物 · 年龄
nodes.explain:
选疑问词只看一件事：划线部分是什么身份。身份对上号，疑问词就定了：

划的是什么用哪个疑问词讲义例句
地点whereThey are studying Chinese in China. → Where are they studying Chinese?
一般时间（年、月、日子）whenShe came to France in 1990. → When did she come to France?
钟点（几点几分）what timeHe often goes to bed at ten. → What time does he often go to bed?
谁whoThey often go home with Tom. → Who do they often go home with?
谁的whose（后面跟名词）I met my father. → Whose father did you meet?
年龄how oldThe man over there is sixty. → How old is the man over there?
哪一个which（后面跟名词）She likes the new skirt. → Which skirt does she like?
颜色what colourHer blouse is white. → What colour is her blouse?

记法：in 1990（年份）→ when，at 7:30（钟点）→ what time——「年月日找 when，几点几分找 what time」；whose / which 是「带名词上班」的疑问词，后面必须跟名词：Whose bike / Which skirt。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：基础疑问词选哪个

general_qs.stem: They will meet at the park tomorrow. → ________ will they meet tomorrow?（对 at the park 提问）
general_qs.explain: at the park 是地点 → where。地点永远派 where 上场，认准「在哪儿」这个意思。

general_qs.stem: She usually eats breakfast at 7:30. → ________ does she usually eat breakfast?（对 at 7:30 提问）
general_qs.explain: at 7:30 是钟点（几点几分）→ what time。若是 in 1990 / on Monday 这类大块时间，才轮到 when。

general_qs.stem: My brother is fifteen years old. → ________ is your brother?（对 fifteen years old 提问）
general_qs.explain: 对年龄提问 → how old。注意提问后问的对象是 your brother，题干里人称已经换好了。

general_qs.stem: Kate's bike was stolen last week. → ________ bike was stolen last week?（对 Kate's 提问）
general_qs.explain: Kate's 表示「凯特的」→ whose（谁的），且后面照常跟名词 bike：Whose bike was stolen last week?

general_qs.stem: She likes the new skirt. → ________ skirt does she like?（对 the new 提问）
general_qs.explain: 「新裙子」是从好几条里挑出「哪一个」→ Which skirt。B 的 whose 问归属（谁的），方向不对；what skirt 不带挑选的意味，问颜色材质才用它。

general_qs.stem: Her blouse is white. → ________ ________ is her blouse?（对 white 提问）
general_qs.explain: 对颜色提问固定用 what colour：What colour is her blouse? — White.

general_qs.stem: They often go home with Tom. → ________ do they often go home with?（对 Tom 提问）
general_qs.explain: Tom 是「人」→ who：Who do they often go home with? 疑问词作介词 with 的宾语时，介词可以留在句尾。B 的 whose 后面得跟名词。

general_qs.stem: She came to France in 1990. 对 in 1990 划线提问，哪句对？
options: What time did she come to France?
When did she come to France?
How long did she come to France?
How soon did she come to France?
general_qs.answer: B. When did she come to France?
general_qs.explain: in 1990 是一般时间（年份）→ when。A 的 what time 只管钟点（at 7:30）；C 的 how long 问时间段「持续多久」；D 的 how soon 问「还要多久」，方向全不对。

memory.front: 对地点、时间、谁、谁的、年龄、颜色、哪一个提问，各用哪个疑问词？
memory.back:
地点→where　一般时间→when　钟点→what time
谁→who　谁的→whose+名词　年龄→how old
哪一个→which+名词　颜色→what colour
口诀：年月日找 when，几点几分找 what time；whose / which 后面必须跟名词
例：in 1990→When；at 7:30→What time；Kate's bike→Whose bike

nodes.title: ③ how 家族大点兵：多久 · 多久一次 · 多少 · 多远
nodes.explain:
how 是疑问副词里的「大户」，自己不带兵，全靠词组扩军。每个词组盯一种身份：

词组盯什么讲义例句
how long时间段（for / since）· 物体长度We have stayed here for six years. → How long have you stayed here?
how often频度（once a week）She is late for school once a week. → How often is she late for school?
how soonin + 时间段（还要多久，常配将来时）Lucy will be back in four days. → How soon will Lucy be back?
how far距离It's 300 metres from my home to school. → How far is it from your home to school?
how many可数名词的数量（+ 复数名词）There are ten books on the desk. → How many books are there on the desk?
how much不可数名词的数量 · 钱数价钱She spent ten yuan on the book. → How much did she spend on the book?
how many times次数He watched TV twice last week. → How many times did he watch TV last week?
how / how tall / how high / how wide方式方法 · 身高（人）· 高度（物）· 宽度We come to school on foot. → How do you come to school? / The hill is 300 metres high. → How high is the hill?

记法：how many 接可数、how much 接不可数和钱；「多久以后」how soon 配 in，「多久一次」how often 配 once / twice a week；问人高 how tall、问物高 how high。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：how 家族大点兵

general_qs.stem: There are twenty students in the classroom. → ________ students are there in the classroom?（对 twenty 提问）
general_qs.explain: students 可数 → how many + 复数名词：How many students are there in the classroom? 不可数的量才用 how much。

general_qs.stem: She usually comes to school by bike. → ________ does she usually come to school?（对 by bike 提问）
general_qs.explain: by bike 是「方式、方法」→ how（怎么来）。how 单独用就管「方式 / 感觉如何」：How do you come to school?

general_qs.stem: He visits his grandparents once a week. → ________ does he visit his grandparents?（对 once a week 提问）
general_qs.explain: once a week 是频度（多久一次）→ how often。注意别和 how many times（问次数）混：how often 问频率，答语是一周几次这类节奏词。

general_qs.stem: He watched TV twice last week. → ________ ________ ________ ________ he watch TV last week?（对 twice 提问，4 词）
general_qs.explain: twice 是次数 → how many times，再借过去时的助动词 did：How many times did he watch TV last week? 原动词 watched 已交给 did，后面用原形 watch。

general_qs.stem: Lucy will be back in four days. → ________ ________ ________ Lucy be back?（对 in four days 提问，3 词）
general_qs.explain: in + 时间段 = 「多久以后」→ how soon，常配将来时：How soon will Lucy be back? how long 问的是「已持续多久」，接不住将来的 in four days。

general_qs.stem: They have some water. → ________ ________ ________ do they have?（对 some water 提问，3 词）
general_qs.explain: water 不可数 → how much + 不可数名词：How much water do they have? some 在疑问句里通常也不再出现。

general_qs.stem: She spent ten yuan on the book. → ________ ________ ________ she spend on the book?（对 ten yuan 提问，3 词）
general_qs.explain: 对钱数、价钱提问 → how much，spent 是过去式，借 did：How much did she spend on the book? spend 交出过去式，变回原形。

general_qs.stem: The hill is 300 metres high. → ________ ________ is the hill?（对 300 metres high 提问）
general_qs.explain: 问「物」的高度用 how high（The man is two metres tall. → How tall is the man? 问人的身高才用 how tall）。C 的 how long 问长度、D 的 how far 问距离，都量错了方向。

memory.front: how long / how often / how soon / how far / how many / how much 各盯什么？
memory.back:
how long 多长多久（for/since 时间段、物体长度）
how often 多久一次（once a week 频度）
how soon 多久以后（in four days，常配将来时）
how far 多远（距离）
how many+可数复数；how much+不可数/价钱
how many times 问次数；问人高 how tall，问物高 how high

nodes.title: ④ what 的多面手：职业 · There be 主语 · 天气 · 星期日期
nodes.explain:
what 是疑问词里的多面手，除了问「某物」「做某事」，还霸占四个固定句型：

问什么句型讲义例句
职业What is/are + 人? ＝ What do/does + 人 + do?His mother is a teacher. → What is his mother? / What does his mother do?
There be 的主语What is/was + 地点?（原句的东西不再出现）There is a book on the desk. → What is on the desk? / There were ten books on the desk. → What was on the desk?
正在 / 经常做某事疑问词用 what，do 的相应形式替换划线部分He is watching TV. → What is he doing? / They often read English. → What do they often do?
天气What is/was … the weather like?Today is rainy. → What is the weather like today?
星期 / 日期星期 What day；日期 What is the dateToday is Friday. → What day is today? / Yesterday was July 1, 1995. → What was the date yesterday?

记法：There be 的主语被提问后，后面的名词要「隐身」、be 一律用单数——What was on the desk?（不再说 books）；问天气别忘了句尾的 like；「星期几」What day，「几月几号」What's the date，两兄弟别串门。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：what 的多面手

general_qs.stem: His mother is a teacher. 对职业提问，正确的是？
general_qs.explain: 问职业两套句型：What is/are + 人？或 What do/does + 人 + do?（= What does his mother do?）。B 问的是「她是谁」（身份姓名）；C 问身体状况；D 把两个句型嫁接错了，is 和 do 不能同框。

general_qs.stem: There is a book on the desk. → ________ on the desk?（对 a book 提问）
general_qs.explain: 对 There be 句型的主语提问，固定 What is/was + 地点：What's on the desk? 原句的 a book 不再出现，提问后 what 自己当主语。

general_qs.stem: There were ten books on the desk. → ________ ________ on the desk?（对 ten books 提问，2 词）
general_qs.explain: 最大陷阱：提问后 books「隐身」，主语变成 what，be 动词跟着用单数 was——What was on the desk? 别写 What were，也别把 books 再搬回来。

general_qs.stem: He is writing a letter now. → ________ ________ he ________ now?（对 writing a letter 提问，3 词）
general_qs.explain: 提问「谓语动词 + 宾语」：疑问词用 what，do 的相应形式替换划线部分——现在进行时借 is，writing 变成 doing：What is he doing now?

general_qs.stem: They often read English in the morning. → ________ ________ they often ________ in the morning?（对 read English 提问，3 词）
general_qs.explain: 读的东西是「做某事」→ what + do 的相应形式：一般现在时复数借 do，原动词 read 变回原形 do——What do they often do in the morning? 第一个 do 是助动词，第二个 do 才是「干」本身。
问天气固定句型 What is/was … the weather like? = What is the weather like today? 句尾的 like 千万别丢，丢了句子就断了。

general_qs.stem: Today is Friday. 对星期提问，正确的是？
options: What is the weather like today?
general_qs.explain: 问「星期几」用 What day；问「几月几号」才用 What is the date（Yesterday was July 1. → What was the date yesterday?）。A 问日期、C 问钟点、D 问天气，全串门了。

memory.front: 问职业、问 There be 主语、问天气、问星期 / 日期，各用什么句型？
memory.back:
职业：What is/are + 人? = What do/does + 人 + do?
There be 主语：What is/was + 地点?（名词隐身，be 用单数 What was on the desk?）
天气：What is/was the weather like?（别丢 like）
星期：What day is today?　日期：What is the date today?

nodes.title: ⑤ 语序三定律：问主语和问其他成分不一样
nodes.explain:
陈述句变特殊疑问句，语序分三种情况，分清就不会乱：

① 问主语（或主语的定语）：疑问词直接替换，语序完全不动。

Tom often comes to China. → Who often comes to China? / Tom's father is a doctor. → Whose father is a doctor? / The girl in red is Kate. → Which girl is Kate?

② 问定语：疑问词连同后面的名词一起提前。

That's our school. → Whose school is that? / He knows the girl in red. → Which girl does he know?

③ 问谓语动词及宾语：疑问词用 what，用 do 的相应形式替换划线部分。

They often read English in the morning. → What do they often do in the morning? / He is writing a letter now. → What is he doing now?

再加三个小贴士：否定式——Why don't you ask Jim? = Why not ask Jim?；双疑问词——疑问部分可以有两个以上疑问词：When and where were you born?；介词可提前——What do you want a computer for? = For what do you want a computer?（For what = Why）。

记法：问主语最省事——谁当主语谁直接上，后面一个字不改；问其他成分，一律「疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序」。

general_qs.stem: Tom often comes to China. 对 Tom（主语）提问，正确的是？
options: Who do often come to China?
general_qs.answer: A. Who often comes to China?
general_qs.explain: 对句首主语提问：疑问词直接替换，语序完全不变，三单 comes 原地保留。B 死于多加了个 do（问主语不用借助动词）；C 的 whom 是宾格，当不了主语；D 的 whose 后面必须跟名词。
Tom's 是主语的定语：whose 替换 Tom's，father 留在原地，整句语序照旧——Whose father is a doctor? 问主语的定语，和问主语一样「不动刀」。

general_qs.stem: That's our school. → ________ ________ is that?（对 our 提问，2 词）
general_qs.explain: 提问部分作定语时，要连同后面的名词一起提前：our school → Whose school is that? 只把 Whose 提出来、丢下 school，句子就不通了。

general_qs.stem: He knows the girl in red. → ________ ________ does he know?（对 the girl in red 提问，2 词）
general_qs.explain: in red 是定语，「穿红衣的那个女孩」是在一群女孩里挑「哪一个」→ Which girl 连同名词提前。这不是问「谁」（who 不带挑选范围），也不是问「谁的」。

general_qs.stem: Why don't you ask Jim? = ________ ________ ________ Jim?（同义句，3 词）
general_qs.explain: 否定式特殊疑问句：Why don't you do…? = Why not do…? not 后面直接跟动词原形 ask，you 和 don't 都省掉了。

general_qs.stem: I was born in Beijing in 2000. → ________ and ________ were you born?（对 in Beijing 和 in 2000 一起提问）
general_qs.explain: 疑问部分可以有两个以上疑问词，用 and 连起来：When and where were you born? 习惯上 when 在前、where 在后——时间地点一起问，一箭双雕。

memory.front: 特殊疑问句的语序：问主语和问其他成分有什么不同？
memory.back:
问主语（或主语的定语）：疑问词直接替换，语序不变——Who often comes to China?
问其他成分：疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序——Where are they studying Chinese?
定语提问连名词一起提前——Whose school is that?
问谓语用 what + do 替换——What do they often do?
否定式：Why don't you…? = Why not…?

nodes.title: ⑥ 易错七对：一眼辨出疑问词真身
nodes.explain:
这一关全是「同一句话、两种问法」的坑。划线部分站的角度不同，疑问词就换人：

句子问 A问 B
He has lived in Australia since 2000.住了多久 → How long从何时起 → Since when
I play football twice a week.多久一次 → How often一周几次 → How many times a week
It's 100 meters from my home to school. / The street is 100 meters from east to west.距离 → How far长度 → How long
They have been to the Great Wall. / They visited the Great Wall.去了哪 → Where参观了什么 → What
They go to work at seven. / Boss will visit next month.钟点 → What time大致时间 → When
It's Monday today. / It's August 27th today.星期 → What day日期 → What is the date
There are over 3,000 people in the village. / The population of the village is over 3,000.多少人 → How many people人口多少 → What is the population

记法：问「多久」还是问「从何时起」，看刀口落在时间段还是起点上；it 指「两地的距离」用 how far，问街道本身多长用 how long；population（人口）是抽象名词，固定用 What 提问。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2：易错七对辨真身

general_qs.stem: It took him 10 minutes to wash the dishes. → ________ did it take him to wash the dishes?（对 10 minutes 提问）
general_qs.explain: it takes sb + 时间 = 「花多长时间」→ 问时间段用 how long：How long did it take him to wash the dishes?

general_qs.stem: It's 10 minutes' ride from my home to school. → ________ is it from my home to school?（对 10 minutes' ride 提问）
general_qs.explain: 10 minutes' ride 说的是「10 分钟的车程」——问的是距离多远，不是花的时间 → how far。和上一题一字之差，答案就换人。

general_qs.stem: They have visited the Summer Palace. → ________ have they visited?（对 the Summer Palace 提问）
general_qs.explain: the Summer Palace 是 visited 的宾语（参观的「物」）→ What have they visited? 如果对地点状语提问（去了哪儿）才用 where——Where have they been?

general_qs.stem: He has lived in Australia since 2000. 问「住了多久」→ ________ has he lived in Australia?
general_qs.explain: since 2000 到现在是一段时间 → 问「持续多久」用 how long：How long has he lived in Australia?

general_qs.stem: He has lived in Australia since 2000. 问「从什么时候开始住」→ ________ has he lived in Australia?
general_qs.explain: 同一句话换个刀口：问起点 → Since when…? 介词 since 要跟着疑问词一起提到句首。对比记忆：How long 问段，Since when 问点。

general_qs.stem: It's 100 meters from my home to school. → ________ is it from my home to school?（对 100 meters 提问）
general_qs.explain: it 指「家到学校」这段路，问的是距离 → how far：How far is it from your home to school?

general_qs.stem: The street is 100 meters from east to west. → ________ is the street from east to west?（对 100 meters 提问）
general_qs.explain: 这里问的是街道「本身有多长」→ how long：How long is the street from east to west? 记住分工：两地隔多远 how far，东西本身多长 how long。

general_qs.stem: The population of the village is over 3,000. → ________ is the population of the village?
general_qs.explain: population（人口）是抽象名词，固定用 What 提问：What is the population of the village? 对比例句 There are over 3,000 people. 里的 people 才用 How many people 提问。

memory.front: since 2000 有哪两种问法？twice a week 呢？population 用什么问？
memory.back:
since 2000：问多久 → How long…?　问起点 → Since when…?
twice a week：问频度 → How often…?　问次数 → How many times a week…?
距离 How far，长度 How long
been to 去了哪 → Where…?　visited 参观了什么 → What…?
at seven → What time；next month → When
星期 What day；日期 What is the date
人口 population 用 What 提问

nodes.title: ⑦ 综合验收：六关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面六关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：when / what time 分工 · how 家族四兄弟（how soon / how long / how often）· what 的固定句型（职业 / There be 主语 / 日期）· 主语提问语序不变 · 易错对（How far vs How long）。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: Lucy will be back in four days. → ________ ________ Lucy be back?（对 in four days 提问，2 词）
general_qs.explain: in + 时间段 = 「多久以后」→ how soon，配将来时（回③）。A 的 how long 问已持续的时间段；C 问频度；D 问距离，全接不住 in four days。

general_qs.stem: His mother is a teacher. 对职业提问，正确的是？
general_qs.explain: 问职业：What is/are + 人?（= What does his mother do?）（回④）。A 问身份姓名，C 问身体状况，D 问地点——她妈妈又不在问题上。

general_qs.stem: There were ten books on the desk. → ________ ________ on the desk?（对 ten books 提问，2 词）
general_qs.explain: 对 There be 主语提问：What is/was + 地点，名词 books 隐身、be 用单数 was——What was on the desk?（回④）写 What were 的都是被 books 带偏了。

general_qs.stem: Tom often comes to China. 对主语提问，正确的是？
options: Who does often come to China?
general_qs.answer: A. Who often comes to China?
general_qs.explain: 问主语直接替换、语序不变，comes 原地保留（回⑤）。C 死于画蛇添足加 does；B 的 whom 是宾格；D 的 whose 后面得跟名词。

general_qs.stem: I have been studying English for five years. → ________ have you been studying English?（对 for five years 提问）
general_qs.explain: for five years 是时间段 → how long（回③）。how soon 接不住 for——它只盯 in + 时间段。

general_qs.stem: It is August 27th today. 对日期提问，正确的是？
general_qs.answer: B. What is the date today?
general_qs.explain: 问「几月几号」用 What is the date；What day 问星期（回④⑥）。C 问钟点，D 问天气——一个句子四个疑问方向，别串门。

general_qs.stem: She came to France in 1990. → ________ did she come to France?（对 in 1990 提问）
general_qs.explain: in 1990 是一般时间（年份）→ when（回②）。what time 只管几点几分。

general_qs.stem: The exam makes me so worried. → ________ makes you so worried?（对 The exam 提问）
general_qs.explain: The exam 是主语（某物）→ 用 what 替换，语序不变：What makes you so worried?（回④⑤）B 的 who 问人，C 的 which 要先有挑选范围，D 的 whose 得跟名词。
